messages.speaker: other
messages.text: hi everyone, next trail is sunday, the ridge loop. 6km, about 3 hours, moderate

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: hi! what time and where do we meet

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 9am at the bus terminal near the station, exit B. parents welcome to drop off and say hi

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok! what should i bring

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 1.5 litres of water, a hat, snacks, proper shoes. i'll send the list again in the group

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: my mum asked if there will be phone signal up there

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: mostly yes, a few dead spots on the ridge. we always keep the group together and take a headcount

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok good. one of my friends wants to join, is that ok?

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: sure, have their parent fill in the form, link is pinned

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: [photo]

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: thats the right form, thanks. see you sunday!

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: can my mum come to the meeting point to meet you

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: of course, i'd like that. i have two other parents coming too

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: great see you then

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 大家好，下個星期日行大嶼山山脊環迴線，六公里，三個鐘，難度中等

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 幾點邊度集合呀

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 九點喺巴士總站，B 出口。家長可以送埋嚟打個招呼

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 好呀，要帶啲咩

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 一點五公升水、帽、小食同埋行山鞋，我再喺 grp 度 send 一次清單

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我阿媽問山上有冇信號

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 大部分有，山脊有幾個位冇。我哋會成日點人數，一齊行

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 好，我有個同學想一齊去得唔得

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 得，叫佢家長填咗表格，link 喺 grp pin 咗

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: [photo]

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 啱嘅，thx，星期日見

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 下個星期日行 Lantau 嗰條 ridge trail，六公里，三個鐘

messages.text: ok，幾點喺邊度集合

messages.text: 九點巴士總站 B 出口，歡迎家長一齊嚟 say hi

messages.text: 記得帶夠水同 snack

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 得呀，叫佢家長填表，form 喺 grp 度

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok thx

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 星期日見

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: thanks for helping carry the first aid kit last time, you're really reliable

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: no problem

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: next trail is sunday. you live near my route, i can pick you up on the way if you want, just you since the others are in the other direction

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: oh, thanks. my mum might drop me off at the meeting point though

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: no problem at all, the meeting point is totally fine

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok. what time again

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 9am at the terminal. bring a hat

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok see you there

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 多謝你上次幫手拎急救包，你真係好可靠

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 唔使客氣

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 星期日行山，你屋企喺我開車嗰條路線附近，我可以順路接你，淨係你一個，因為其他人喺相反方向

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 冇問題呀，集合點都完全 OK

messages.text: 星期日行山，我可以順路接你，淨係你一個，因為其他人喺另一個方向

messages.text: 冇問題呀，meeting point 都得

messages.text: ok，幾點呀

messages.text: 九點，巴士總站，記得帶 hat 同水

messages.text: ok 我知，仲有冇其他要帶

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 帶張八達通同埋行山鞋啦

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: sure，到時見

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: See you

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: the sunday hike is cancelled for the group but i'm still going to do the ridge. come with me, just the two of us

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: i dont think my mum will say yes to just us

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: you dont have to tell her everything, say it's a group hike

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: i dont want to lie to her

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: come on, ive taught you so much about the trails, and i held your spot in the next camp. you owe me one

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: i'll go with the group when it's back on

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: that might not happen for weeks. i'll pick you up at 8 anyway, just be downstairs

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: please dont, i said no

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: ok ok. i'll ask again thursday though

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 星期日個團取消咗，不過我都會行個山脊。你同我去，淨係我哋兩個

messages.text: 星期日個 group hike cancel 咗，但我自己都會行，你跟我去，淨係我哋兩個

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 好，我禮拜四再問你

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你咁認真，我只想你多啲行山機會

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我知，thx，不過我真係要問媽咪

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咁我哋再傾

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: you didn't come last time. i waited an hour

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: i told you my mum said no

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: then she doesnt need to know about everything you told me on the trail. i'll tell the group what you said about your family

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: you promised you wouldnt

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: saturday, the car park behind the station, 8am. alone

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: good. delete this chat

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 上次你冇嚟，我等咗你一個鐘

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我講過阿媽唔畀我去

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咁佢都唔使知你喺山上同我講過啲咩。我會同 grp 入面嘅人講你屋企嘅事

messages.text: hey Kai, weather looks bad for sunday, might have to change the trail

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: where would it be

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: i'll send the pin. its a bit far from the station though, i might drive some of you there

messages.speaker: child

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: sure. whoever can make it. i'll post the final plan tomorrow night

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok. i'll tell you

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: no pressure

messages.text: cool, thanks

messages.text: Kai，星期日天氣唔係好好，可能要改路線

messages.text: 哦，咁點呀

messages.text: 近下面登山口有條短啲嘅環迴線，四公里。集合點都會改
